data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for app termination, process restart, and optional data clearing.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to restart their Flutter application either through a UI-only refresh or a full native process restart. It supports optional user confirmation dialogs and selective data management like clearing local storage or preserving keys.
use_when: You need to programmatically restart the app after an update or language change
You require a full process restart or a quick UI-only refresh
You want to prompt users with a confirmation dialog before terminating the app
avoid_when: You only need standard deep linking or URL launching without restarting the entire app
Your architecture heavily relies on maintaining persistent background isolates that cannot be cleanly reset
strengths: Offers both UI-only and full process restart modes
Includes built-in user confirmation dialog options
Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms with granular data clearing and preservation settings
weaknesses: Requires iOS Info.plist URL scheme configurations for proper restarting
Terminating processes on mobile platforms can be abrupt if not managed carefully
data.setup_notes: Requires adding URL scheme entries to Info.plist on iOS for restart functionality to work properly, and wrapping the app with TerminateRestart.wrapWithRestart for UI-only resets.
